plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 240 mm/min, tip cap 300 mm/min (tapered ball nose 2.0 mm is outside tip 0.5-1.5875 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The tapered ball nose rule g10_plunge_tapered covers tip 0.5-1.5875 mm only; this tool is 2.0 mm. The tip cap 300 mm/min at a tip of 2.0 mm: no stored source; repo rule 150 mm/min per mm of tip (a code comment cites FSWizard / GWizard 100-300 mm/min; not stored). The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).
